# U175: Amara switches AI access off (SW2): it is under Beyond this workspace, and with no token it acts at once; then Workspace has no AI access section, /workspace/ai says it is switched off, Access is the admins only, Settings has no “Your MCP tokens” and the inbox’s Connect Claude says it is switched off, with a link to Features; switched back on, the section is back after Access

- **Belongs to:** the AI access module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `AI-ACCESS-OPTIONAL`, `FEATURE-GROUPS`, `MODULES`
- **Budget:** 12 steps, not scored: this journey’s ease test leaves `budget` out, so it may take more (the steps below are counted all the same)
- **Ease test:** every point but `parity`, `budget` ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/workspace/ai` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U175

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- _Note:_ On: AI access is its own section after Access (SW2), with the tokens; Access names the admins only.
- Go to `/workspace/ai` in the demo.
- **Check:** “The MCP tokens that let an AI tool act as someone here.” is shown (else: AI access is not its own Workspace section).
- Go to `/workspace/features` in the demo.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “AI access” tick box is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if AI access is not under Beyond this workspace.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “features”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ The demo has no token (they work only in the real app), so switching off acts at once: nothing to name.
- **Step.** Press the “AI access” tick box.
- **Check:** “AI access is off in” is shown.
- **Check:** It fails if with no token, switching AI access off still asked first.
- **Check:** (`one-action`) scored as met here.
- _Note:_ Its section is gone: not in the menu, and its address says it is off.
- Go to `/workspace/access` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Who the admins are.” is shown.
- **Check:** It fails if Access still lists MCP tokens with AI access off.
- **Check:** It fails if Workspace’s menu still has AI access.
- Go to `/workspace/ai` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Page not found” is shown.
- **Check:** “AI access is switched off in” is shown (else: /workspace/ai does not say AI access is switched off).
- _Note:_ Settings: no “Your MCP tokens”.
- Go to `/settings` in the demo.
- **Check:** The page (`.page`) shows.
- **Check:** “Settings” is shown.
- **Check:** It fails if Settings still has “Your MCP tokens” with AI access off.
- _Note:_ The inbox's Connect Claude says it is off, and gives no set-up for a server that refuses every call (review of #504).
- Go to `/feedback` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “Connect Claude” button in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Check:** “AI access is switched off in” is shown in the connect (`.connect`) in the inbox (`#inbox`) (else: with AI access off, Connect Claude does not say so).
- **Check:** It fails if with AI access off, Connect Claude still gives the set-up.
- **Check:** It fails if Connect Claude does not link an admin to Workspace, Features.
- **Check:** (`logged`) it fails if switching AI access off was not logged.
- _Note:_ Back on: the section is back.
- Go to `/workspace/features` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “AI access” tick box.
- **Check:** “AI access is on in” is shown.
- Go to `/workspace/ai` in the demo.
- **Check:** “The MCP tokens that let an AI tool act as someone here.” is shown (else: AI access back on, its section is not back).
- Go to `/settings` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Your MCP tokens” is shown (else: AI access back on, Settings has no “Your MCP tokens”).
- **Check:** (`finish`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** (`progress`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** (`errors`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
